comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
New MA from Seven Wonders Chapter 1. For probably good reason, it listed all the items just like older starter MA works (for example: Personification of Gods MA).

Ancient Priest's Knowledge Book - Obtained from Sophia Awakening recipe. Accesories.
Capstone Pendant - Obtained from Great Pyramid of Giza legacy site. Consumables.
Special Blue-gray Wooden Paneling - Obtained from Sophia Awakening recipe. Ship Parts.
Ankh Anchor - Obtained from Sophia Awakening recipe. Deco Ship.
The Rosetta Stone - Obtained from Sophia Awakening recipe. Deco Ship.
Sailors' Ancient Art of Surveying - Obtained from Sophia Awakening recipe. Sailor Equipment.
Storage Man's Techniques Book - Obtained from Sophia Awakening. Sailor Equipment.

The reward is Royal Necklace

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: This is why removing an in-game item was never a good idea. You will never know that some items will be crucial for future release. Hopefully, they will at least release it in cove or something in future.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Update: This album can finally be completed with the Anchor's release in a recent cove/c-ticket. Assuming you can find and purchase an Anchor from another player, or win it yourself. Best of luck with that.

comments.author: shoelace
comments.body:

Everlasting or Super-ancient or Occult or Greater or Nile
Pharaoh or Summiteer or Priest or Lion or Triangle

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: Just a tip, you can't get the custom nicknames until you complete the MA + pick up your MA reward.
